records.public_safe_text: units 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 were in the parking lot of the business at [roadway]. which is gas station/convenience store. unit 2 was parked directly in front of the store. units 3 and 4 were parked at fuel pumps and were unoccupied. unit 5, a pedestrian, had just exited unit 4 and was about to begin fueling it. unit 1 was eastbound pulling up to a fuel pump. while attempting to stop the driver of unit 1 misapplied the foot pedal and pressed the accelerator instead of the brake. unit 1 traveled though the parking lot in an arc. unit 1 collided front left to the left back quarter of unit 2. it continued and collided right distributed to the front right of unit 3. it then collided front to fuel pumps and pushed those pumps into unit 5 and possibly unit 4. the collision caused fuel to spill and ignite. units 1 and 4 burned.

records.deidentified_narrative: [roadway] [roadway]. accident occurred in the private parking lot at the circle k corner store. unit #2 (pedestrian) and witness were walking out of the circle k after buying two big gulps to the witness' vehicle which was parked at the pumps. unit #2 stated that while walking to the vehicle, unit #1 began to [roadway] and collided into him. unit #2 stated that unit #1 collided into his right arm/side area. unit #2 stated driver of unit #1 exited the vehicle and talked to him then left the scene shortly after. unit #2 called police and fms to treat his injuries and file a police report. unit #2 stated his right arm began to hurt and was transported by rescue-22 to del sol west for treatment. officer observed the surveillance video from the circle k which showed unit #1 begin to back very slowly striking unit #2. officer observed the impact to be minor to the degree that unit #1 (pedestrian) didn't drop his drink that was purchased. driver of unit #1 exited the vehicle which appeared to be a young male and talked to unit #2 and the witness. after the conversation, unit #2 and witness walked away and unit #1 drove off west on n. desert. witness: roberto carlos corral ([date]) tx dl 41198836

records.deidentified_narrative: disclaimer- the following is a written summary of the events described. it does not contain all comments made during the event, all facts or circumstances relevant to this investigation, nor does it necessarily reflect the chronology of the event. all statements or interviews have been paraphrased in this report unless quotation marks are used. verbatim statements can be obtained by watching my body worn camera footage. the purpose of this report is to assist in refreshing my memory to testify accurately. on the listed date and time while on patrol, police responded to the listed location for a report of a major accident involving 2 pedestrians and 2 vehicles. i made location and contact with sgt. g. adams #9574. safd was onsite and evaluating p1 and p2. sgt. adams advised me that p1 and p2 were both hit by vehicle 2. i made contact with driver 1 and asked her what happened. driver 1 stated she was following the flow [roadway] and vehicle 2 was to her left. driver 1 says she was not trying to change lanes and she thinks that the vehicles were too close to each other and that is why they collided. driver 1 says she did not observed vehicle 2 with its turn signal on. driver 1 told me she was not injured at that time. i observed damage on the driver side front fender and bumper of vehicle 1. driver 2 stated that he was traveling with the flow of traffic as well when he felt his vehicle collied with vehicle 1. driver 2 stated he did not observe vehicle 1 [roadway] change but believes she was trying to turn in front of him. driver 2 states that due to the impact, his vehicle was pushed to the left and on the sidewalk where his vehicle hit pedestrian 1 and pedestrian 2. i observed damage to the passenger side front fender and bumper of vehicle 2. sgt. adams provided information for pedestrian 3 who claimed to have observed the accident and was the only person to come forward and provide their information. pedestrian 3's number is [phone]. engine 3 fire fighters cleared pedestrian 1 and 2 of medical emergencies. pedestrians 1 and 2 were provided a card with my name, badge number, and [case id]. pedestrian 1 and 2 departed without further incident. drivers 1 and 2 were provided crash forms and departed without further incident. body worn camera is available. no further action taken.

investigation, nor does it necessarily reflect the chronology of the event. all statements or interviews have been paraphrased in this report unless quotation marks are used. verbatim statements can be obtained by watching my body worn camera footage. the purpose of this report is to assist in refreshing my memory to testify accurately. on the listed date and time while on patrol, police responded to the listed location for a report of a major accident involving 2 pedestrians and 2 vehicles. i made location and contact with sgt. g. adams #9574. safd was onsite and evaluating p1 and p2. sgt. adams advised me that p1 and p2 were both hit by vehicle 2. i made contact with driver 1 and asked her what happened. driver 1 stated she was following the flow [roadway] and vehicle 2 was to her left. driver 1 says she was not trying to change lanes and she thinks that the vehicles were too close to each other and that is why they collided. driver 1 says she did not observed vehicle 2 with its turn signal on. driver 1 told me she was not injured at that time. i observed damage on the driver side front fender and bumper of vehicle 1. driver 2 stated that he was traveling with the flow of traffic as well when he felt his vehicle collied with vehicle 1. driver 2 stated he did not observe vehicle 1 [roadway] change but believes she was trying to turn in front of him. driver 2 states that due to the impact, his vehicle was pushed to the left and on the sidewalk where his vehicle hit pedestrian 1 and pedestrian 2. i observed damage to the passenger side front fender and bumper of vehicle 2. sgt. adams provided information for pedestrian 3 who claimed to have observed the accident and was the only person to come forward and provide their information. pedestrian 3's number is [phone]. engine 3 fire fighters cleared pedestrian 1 and 2 of medical emergencies. pedestrians 1 and 2 were provided a card with my name, badge number, and [case id]. pedestrian 1 and 2 departed without further incident. drivers 1 and 2 were provided crash forms and departed without further incident. body worn camera is available. no further action taken.

records.deidentified_narrative: on the above listed date and time police responded to the listed location for a major accident. upon arrival i observed a silver dodge ram 1500 blocking traffic for u2 (pedestrian) who was laying in the roadway face down. i also observed debris in the roadway starting at the crosswalk of the listed crash location (boots, hat, and an electric scooter). i approached u2 who was unresponsive and not breathing. i rolled u2 onto his back and checked for a pulse but did not feel anything. i immediately began chest compressions and notified dispatch. i continued chest compressions until safd ems arrived on scene. i checked for pulse again and felt a pulse on u2 upon the arrival of ems. ems the took over the [medical facility] in critical condition with life threatening injuries. officer gonzalez #[medical facility]. i then made contact with the people who were around u2 upon my arrival. after speaking with them i determined there were no witnesses to the accident. officer rodriguez #1756 made contact with the original caller who was also the driver of the silver dodge ram 1500 blocking u2 in the roadway. according to the original caller they did not see the accident or u1 leaving the scene. while searching the area i also observed security cameras that face the direction of the crash location at a nearby business. i then contacted the gap detective, det. lindley #2722, and advised her of the incident. i was advised by det. lindley #2722 to hold the scene down until tid was able to make scene. csi bustamante #9417 arrived to the crash location and processed the scene. while waiting for tid a separate call to 911 came in from another location advising they believed they hit an unknown object on s general mcmullen. sgt hollifield #3110 and officer mercado #1074 arrived to that secondary location and confirmed that is was u1 and u1 driver. tid arrived on scene and conducted their investigation at the original crash location. myself and tid then relocated to where u1 and u1 driver were located. i observed damage to the front bumper, hood, and windshield to u1. i also observed blood and a strand of hair in the broken front windshield of u1. i then stood by with tid det. gurrola #2631 while he spoke with u1 driver. u1 driver stated she was traveling nb on s general mcmullen in the number 1 lane. u1 driver stated she then changed lanes to the number 2 lane behind a white pickup. u1 driver stated that pickup then swerved to the left and u1 driver stated something hit her vehicle. u1 driver stated she did not know what she hit but she did see the damage to her vehicle. u1 driver [roadway] home and did not stop to see what she hit. u1 driver stated after she returned home she called police to report the accident. det. gurrola #2631 advised me to conduct hgn on u1 driver. i conducted hgn on u1 driver and did not observe any clues. i also did not observe any other signs of intoxication on u1 driver. csi enriquez #9436 arrived to process u1. officer mercado #1074 towed u1 to growdon impound and placed a hold on u1 for tid under tsr [identifier]. evidence of u1 was later found at the crash scene to include the j and e of the jeep logo that was missing from the hood of u1 . i was advised by det. gurrola #2631 to also complete a mark 43 report for failure to stop and render aid sbi along with the crash report. please reference mark 43 report for more information completed under this [case id]. u1 driver was given a case card and [case id] along with the contact information for the proper follow-up unit. axon fleet/bwc available.

(pedestrian) who was laying in the roadway face down. i also observed debris in the roadway starting at the crosswalk of the listed crash location (boots, hat, and an electric scooter). i approached u2 who was unresponsive and not breathing. i rolled u2 onto his back and checked for a pulse but did not feel anything. i immediately began chest compressions and notified dispatch. i continued chest compressions until safd ems arrived on scene. i checked for pulse again and felt a pulse on u2 upon the arrival of ems. ems the took over the [medical facility] in critical condition with life threatening injuries. officer gonzalez #[medical facility]. i then made contact with the people who were around u2 upon my arrival. after speaking with them i determined there were no witnesses to the accident. officer rodriguez #1756 made contact with the original caller who was also the driver of the silver dodge ram 1500 blocking u2 in the roadway. according to the original caller they did not see the accident or u1 leaving the scene. while searching the area i also observed security cameras that face the direction of the crash location at a nearby business. i then contacted the gap detective, det. lindley #2722, and advised her of the incident. i was advised by det. lindley #2722 to hold the scene down until tid was able to make scene. csi bustamante #9417 arrived to the crash location and processed the scene. while waiting for tid a separate call to 911 came in from another location advising they believed they hit an unknown object on s general mcmullen. sgt hollifield #3110 and officer mercado #1074 arrived to that secondary location and confirmed that is was u1 and u1 driver. tid arrived on scene and conducted their investigation at the original crash location. myself and tid then relocated to where u1 and u1 driver were located. i observed damage to the front bumper, hood, and windshield to u1. i also observed blood and a strand of hair in the broken front windshield of u1. i then stood by with tid det. gurrola #2631 while he spoke with u1 driver. u1 driver stated she was traveling nb on s general mcmullen in the number 1 lane. u1 driver stated she then changed lanes to the number 2 lane behind a white pickup. u1 driver stated that pickup then swerved to the left and u1 driver stated something hit her vehicle. u1 driver stated she did not know what she hit but she did see the damage to her vehicle. u1 driver [roadway] home and did not stop to see what she hit. u1 driver stated after she returned home she called police to report the accident. det. gurrola #2631 advised me to conduct hgn on u1 driver. i conducted hgn on u1 driver and did not observe any clues. i also did not observe any other signs of intoxication on u1 driver. csi enriquez #9436 arrived to process u1. officer mercado #1074 towed u1 to growdon impound and placed a hold on u1 for tid under tsr [identifier]. evidence of u1 was later found at the crash scene to include the j and e of the jeep logo that was missing from the hood of u1 . i was advised by det. gurrola #2631 to also complete a mark 43 report for failure to stop and render aid sbi along with the crash report. please reference mark 43 report for more information completed under this [case id]. u1 driver was given a case card and [case id] along with the contact information for the proper follow-up unit. axon fleet/bwc available.

records.deidentified_narrative: while on patrol police responded to a call for a major accident. when i arrived on scene, i observed u3 being treated by ems. due to u3's old age and head trauma, ems treated her as a serious bodily injury [medical facility]. it was advised that u3 was standing on the sidewalk when she was struck by the vehicles after they crashed. i spoke with the driver of u2 and she had told me that while [roadway], her vehicle was suddenly struck by u1 from her left side. i spoke with the passenger of u2 and he told me the same thing. both had a hard time recalling the rest of the crash. both didn't complain of any injuries and refused ems, however both occupants were advised that if they felt unusual the next day that it was advised that they seek medical attention. i spoke with u1 and he stated that before he crossed the intersection, he was looking down at his phone and claimed to make a rolling stop at the stop sign. i observed the food mart [roadway] to have cameras and requested the footage to be looked at. upon watching the footage, [roadway] past the stop sign at a speed that showed no indications of slowing down and struck u2 on the drivers side as it was driving past the intersection. upon being struck, u2 recoiled into a tree on the curb, hitting it from the right side of the vehicle, the force from the impact caused the vehicle to be pushed sideways, sliding left. after u2 struck u1, u2 spun and rolled backwards beside u1, striking it again from the right side of u2. it is to be noted that in the footage, i observed u3 standing on the sidewalk moments before the [roadway], u3 was struck by u2 when it was pushed into the sidewalk by the impact, knocking her to the ground and causing her to hit her head on the pavement. u1 was issued a citation for disregarding stop sign ([identifier]). supervisor was contacted and tid made scene. axon available.

records.public_safe_text: police responded to the listed location for an accident major. the notes on the call stated that a white vehicle ran over a male (d1) and the male was not breathing. upon my arrival, ems was already at the location. made contact with ems [roadway]. mcculler safd pronounced the d1 deceased at 0208hrs. i made contact with d1's cousin (o1) who stated that he was dancing at ""la rancherita"" [roadway]. o1 stated that the business was closing down and he was departing the location when he observed a large gathering [roadway]. o1 approached the area and observed a male lying down on the ground. o1 then recognized that d1 was his cousin. i made contact with the security guard of ""la rancherita"" (w1) who stated that he was outside the establishment patrolling the lot. w1 said that a vehicle was departing their lot when he heard a loud noise. w1 said that he believed the sound came from the vehicle that was exiting and possibly crashed. w1 added that right after the loud noise, he heard someone scream. w1 stated that he turned around to where he heard the scream and observed an object flying. w1 stated that the object was d1. w1 said that he believed that the suspect vehicle was a white toyota pilot. w1 continued stating that right after the incident, the suspect vehicle continued [roadway] 90. w1 mentioned that he did not hear the suspect vehicle attempting to break or stop. i made contact with a female who works at a food truck (w2). w2 stated that she observed d1 walk [roadway] to a parking lot that is right in front of ""la rancherita"". w2 added that d1 attempted to go back to [roadway] and crossed [roadway], not at the given crosswalk, when a white truck hit d1. w2 stated that she saw a white tahoe hit d1 and then continued [roadway] 90. iti det. j. manila #2730, csi j. saldivar #9416, and sgt. r. olivares #3182 were notified and made the location. me jerry leyva #105 was notified and took possession of d1. [case id]. fleet/ bwc
